fänden.en: they will find, find (Konjunktiv II of «finden»)

texto: When the form of Konjunktiv I is identical to that of the indicative present (for example, in plural: **sie haben, sie fordern, sie kommen**), the standard German rule requires it to be replaced by the **Konjunktiv II** (**sie hätten, sie forderten, sie kämen**) to clearly point out that these are foreign words.

If the form of Konjunktiv II in turn coincides with the Indicative Präteritum (as in many weak verbs: **sie forderten**), or sounds archaic, the perifrase with **würden + infinitivo** (**sie würden fordern**) is usually used.

frases.de: Die Angestellten fordern, die Arbeitgeber böten ein besseres Gehalt.
frases.es: Los empleados exigen que los empleadores ofrezcan un mejor sueldo.
frases.en: Employees require employers to offer a better salary.

frases.de: Die Unternehmen erwidern, sie hätten bereits erhebliche Kosten.
frases.es: Las empresas replican que ya tienen costes considerables.
frases.en: Companies say they already have considerable costs.

frases.de: Sie behaupten, die Betriebe würden sonst keine Fachkräfte finden.
frases.es: Afirman que las empresas de lo contrario no encontrarían personal cualificado.
frases.en: They claim that companies would otherwise find no qualified staff.
analisis: they would not find qualified personnel

frases.de: Beide Seiten hoffen, sie fänden bald einen Kompromiss.
frases.es: Ambas partes esperan encontrar pronto un acuerdo de compromiso.
frases.en: Both sides hope to find a compromise agreement soon.

bloques.pregunta: When is it mandatory to use a form of substitution in indirect style?

opciones.texto: When the form of the Konjunktiv I is morphologically consistent with the indication.
opciones.explicacion: The replacement ensures that the reader recognizes the speech.

opciones.texto: Exclusively when the speaker wants to express that the statement is a lie.
opciones.explicacion: The Konjunktiv II in indirect style does not qualify veracity, only avoids formal ambiguity.

opciones.texto: Only when the main prayer is conjugated in future time.
opciones.explicacion: The rule depends on the morphological coincidence, not the time of the matrix.

bloques.frase: Die Arbeitgeber betonen, sie ___ bereits erhebliche finanzielle Belastungen.

opciones.explicacion: Konjunktiv II's replacement form against the «sie haben»'s match with the indicative.
It is identical to the present indicative; it does not mark indirect plural style.

bloques.frase: Beide Seiten hoffen, sie fänden bald eine Lösung.

opciones.texto: Both sides hope to find a solution soon.
opciones.explicacion: «fänden» is the Konjunktiv II of «finden», used as a form of substitution.

opciones.texto: Neither side has an interest in resolving the conflict.
opciones.explicacion: The verb «hoffen» (wait) and «Lösung» indicate will to agree.

opciones.texto: Both sides rule out any possible solution.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase expresses hope to reach it soon («bald»).

bloques.pregunta: Why is «sie würden fordern» preferred against «sie forderten» in spoken language and daily press?

opciones.texto: Because «forderten» is identical to the simple (Präteritum) past of indicative and creates temporary confusion.
opciones.explicacion: In weak verbs, the Konjunktiv II formally coincides with the Präteritum.

opciones.texto: Because the verb «fordern» has no conjugation in written German.
opciones.explicacion: All regular verbs have a complete paradigm.

opciones.texto: Porque «würden» solo puede emplearse con sustantivos en singular.
opciones.explicacion: «würden» is the plural conjugate form for «sie» or «wir».

bloques.frase: Die Gewerkschaften fürchten, die Betriebe ___ die Produktion ins Ausland verlagern.

opciones.explicacion: «würden + Infinitiv» provides unequivocal clarity of indirect style without coinciding with the past.
It is indicative of the future; it does not reflect the distance from the indirect style.
It's the passive form in Präteritum.

bloques.frase: Die Unternehmen erwidern, sie hätten keine weiteren Mittel zur Verfügung.

opciones.texto: Replican que no disponen de más fondos para negociar.
opciones.explicacion: «hätten keine weiteren Mittel» expresses the lack of additional resources in indirect style.

opciones.texto: They confirm that they have transferred all their funds to the trade unions.
opciones.explicacion: The phrase indicates a lack of means («keine weiteren Mittel»).

opciones.texto: Celebran que sus beneficios económicos hayan superado las expectativas.
opciones.explicacion: The text transmits an economic limitation, not a celebration of benefits.

bloques.frase: beide Seiten hoffen sie fänden einen Kompromiss
bloques.traduccion: both sides expect to find a compromise
bloques.explicacion: use of Konjunktiv II as a substitute in indirect style.

intro: We study the forms of substitution when the Konjunktiv I coincides with the indicative or is ambiguous.
